website.title: MeetifyNow - Simple Meeting Scheduling Tool
website.description: MeetifyNow helps teams and clients agree on a meeting time fast. Participants answer through a link, no account needed.

home.headerText: No more back-and-forth when scheduling project meetings. Fewer messages to lock in a date.
home.title: Schedule meetings faster — with your team and your clients

fast.title: Fewer messages
fast.text: One link instead of long email threads. Lock in a project meeting in minutes, not days.

everyone.title: With your team and clients
everyone.text: Agree on meeting times with clients without forcing them to sign up for yet another platform.

time.title: Don't waste time logging in
time.text: With MeetifyNow, scheduling meetings becomes even easier - you can do it without logging in! Save valuable time and schedule your meetings in no time!

online.title: Select availability online
online.text: Participants can mark the hours when they're only available remotely, so you can see right away whether the meeting should be online.

flexibleHours.title: Custom Hours
flexibleHours.text: Don't be limited to standard time slots! MeetifyNow allows you to create meetings at any time, adapting to your individual schedule.

items.title: No account for participants
items.desc: Participants just type their name and pick time slots. No accounts, no passwords.

items.title: Calendar view
items.desc: Clear, intuitive interface making it easy to find a common date quickly.

items.title: Smart suggestions
items.desc: The system automatically suggests optimal time windows for the whole group.

howItWorks.subtitle: How does it work?
howItWorks.title: Plan. Choose. Meet.
howItWorks.description: Three simple steps separate you and your team from a perfectly matched schedule. No getting lost in emails.

steps.title: 1. Propose dates
steps.desc: Choose a few convenient options and pack them into a generated link.

steps.title: 2. Send and vote
steps.desc: Share the link with your group. Everyone types their name and picks their hours – no signup.

steps.title: 3. Perfect time
steps.desc: MeetifyNow will highlight the solution that suits the most people within seconds.

cta.title: Simple to use. Powerful in action.
cta.description: Stop exchanging dozens of messages searching for a single matching date.

availability.description: Set when you're usually available for meetings. These rules are used when recommending and confirming dates.
availability.invalidRange: {day}: end must be later than start.
availability.limitsInfo: These limits are checked when you confirm a date: buffers protect the time between meetings, and minimum notice is the shortest time from now a meeting can be booked. You can still confirm a time outside them after an extra confirmation.
availability.exceptionsHint: Block days when you can't take meetings. They're saved immediately — no need to click “Save”.
